# EMET — Gospel of Mary, Chapter 1
**Agent:** EMET (Literal/Transparent)
**Source:** P.Berol. 8502, Gospel of Mary, p. 1-2 | Coptic
**Chapter:** 1

---

[Pages 1-6 of the manuscript are lost. The text begins mid-conversation in chapter 5. Chapters 1-4 are entirely absent from the Coptic manuscript. No Greek fragment covers this portion. The original opening of the Gospel of Mary — likely an introduction, setting, and early dialogue between the risen Jesus and his disciples — cannot be recovered.]

---

*Translator's Note (EMET):* The lacuna encompasses the entire first section of the work. Any rendering of these pages would be reconstruction, not translation. EMET does not supply conjectured text.
